scope: Actual downloaded mainnet program executed in local LiteSVM. FixtureUSDC, fixtureSOL; zero mainnet broadcasts.
boundary: Chain enforces delegate identity, cumulative allowance, expiry and revoke. Job/day/floor checks outside this allowance remain trusted-runtime checks; owner can change authorization or withdraw funds.

rows.name: Owner creates fixed 1 USDC cap, recipient ATA and funds worker gas from 0.008 fixture SOL
Worker transfers0.01 fixture USDC with result hash memo
Replay of identical signed transaction does not debit twice
Unapproved signer cannot pull from delegation
One unit above remaining cap rejects transfer atomically
Maximum original allowance exhausted leaves 2 fixture USDC protected from worker
Exhausted allowance rejects even one base unit
Other signer cannot revoke owner delegation
Owner revokes allowance and recovers delegation rent
Revoked allowance no longer permits transfer
Owner authorizes a short-lived replacement after revocation
Owner revokes expired replacement before returning funds
Owner returns protected fixtureUSDC to configured original operator
Worker returns test settlements to configured original operator
